lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur apanaa sev sabh phal paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Serving my True Guru, I have obtained all the fruits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naau sadaa dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I meditate continually on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kai sa(n)g dukh mitaaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, I am rid of my pain and suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhae achi(n)t har dhan nihachalaaiaa ||20||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I have become care-free; I have obtained the imperishable wealth of the Lord. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤਿ ਮਿਆਲਾ ਉਚੀਆ ਘਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਨਿਰਣਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khet miaalaa ucheeaa ghar uchaa niranau ||
lines.translation: Raising the embankments of the mind's field, I gaze at the heavenly mansion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲ ਭਗਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਸਰੈ ਸਜਣ ਪਾਹੁਣਿਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahal bhagatee ghar sarai sajan paahuniau ||
lines.translation: When devotion comes to the mind of the soul-bride, she is visited by the friendly guest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਸਨਾ ਤ ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਰਸਹਿ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: barasanaa ta baras ghanaa bahuR barasahi kaahi ||
lines.translation: O clouds, if you are going to rain, then go ahead and rain; why rain after the season has passed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tinh balihaaranai jinh guramukh paaiaa man maahi ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who obtain the Lord in their minds. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੋ ਜਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mithaa so jo bhaavadaa sajan so j raas ||
lines.translation: That which is pleasing is sweet, and one who is sincere is a friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh jaaneeai jaa kau aap kare paragaas ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he is known as a Gurmukh, whom the Lord Himself enlightens. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh paas jan kee aradaas too sachaa saa(n)ee ||
lines.translation: O God, Your humble servant offers his prayer to You; You are my True Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too rakhavaalaa sadaa sadaa hau tudh dhiaaee ||
lines.translation: You are my Protector, forever and ever; I meditate on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh teriaa too rahiaa samaaee ||
lines.translation: All the beings and creatures are Yours; You are pervading and permeating in them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo daas tere kee ni(n)daa kare tis maar pachaaee ||
lines.translation: One who slanders Your slave is crushed and destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਛਡਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: chi(n)taa chhad achi(n)t rahu naanak lag paaee ||21||
lines.translation: Falling at Your Feet, Nanak has renounced his cares, and has become care-free. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਆਸਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa karataa jag muaa aasaa marai na jaai ||
lines.translation: Building up its hopes, the world dies, but its hopes do not die or depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aasaa pooreeaa sache siu chit laai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, hopes are fulfilled only by attaching one's consciousness to the True Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa manasaa mar jaaisee jin keetee so lai jaai ||
lines.translation: Hopes and desires shall die only when He, who created them, takes them away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nihachal ko nahee baajhahu har kai naai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, nothing is permanent, except the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape jagat upaaion kar pooraa thaat ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the world, with His perfect workmanship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa aape hee har haat ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the true banker, He Himself is the merchant, and He Himself is the store.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖੇਵਾਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape saagar aape bohithaa aape hee khevaat ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the ocean, He Himself is the boat, and He Himself is the boatman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦਸੇ ਘਾਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape dase ghaat ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Guru, He Himself is the disciple, and He Himself shows the destination.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੁ ॥੨੨॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaai too sabh kilavikh kaat ||22||1|| sudh
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and all your sins shall be eradicated. ||22||1||Sudh||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag goojaree vaar mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Goojaree, Vaar, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar gur aaraadhanaa jihavaa jap gur naau ||
lines.translation: Deep within yourself, worship the Guru in adoration, and with your tongue, chant the Guru's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੇਖਣਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: netree satigur pekhanaa sravanee sunanaa gur naau ||
lines.translation: Let your eyes behold the True Guru, and let your ears hear the Guru's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur setee ratiaa daragah paaeeai thaau ||
lines.translation: Attuned to the True Guru, you shall receive a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਏਹ ਵਥੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa kare jis no eh vath dei ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, this treasure is bestowed on those who are blessed with His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਉਤਮ ਕਾਢੀਅਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jag mahi utam kaadheeahi virale keee kei ||1||
lines.translation: In the midst of the world, they are known as the most pious - they are rare indeed. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਖੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: rakhe rakhanahaar aap ubaarian ||
lines.translation: O Savior Lord, save us and take us across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee pairee paai kaaj savaarian ||
lines.translation: Falling at the feet of the Guru, our works are embellished with perfection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoaa aap daiaal manahu na visaarian ||
lines.translation: You have become kind, merciful and compassionate; we do not forget You from our minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh janaa kai sa(n)g bhavajal taarian ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are carried across the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat ni(n)dak dusat khin maahi bidaarian ||
lines.translation: In an instant, You have destroyed the faithless cynics and slanderous enemies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis saahib kee tek naanak manai maahi ||
lines.translation: That Lord and Master is my Anchor and Support; O Nanak, hold firm in your mind.
